versions.changelog: v2.5.1: send_notification is now gated by ha_confirm like the other service calls (was a direct ha_post, contradicting the documented gating claim - the 98% description-behavior mismatch the re-scan flagged). No new capability.

v2.5.0: cleartext HTTP now fails closed (opt-in HOME_ASSISTANT_ALLOW_HTTP for trusted-LAN plain HTTP); fixed two description-behavior mismatches (accurate gating claim scoped to the gated snippets; accurate credential-source claim).

v2.4.0: removed the TLS-disable path (self-signed via HOME_ASSISTANT_CA_CERT; verify always on); added code-enforced confirmation gate (ha_confirm) for state-changing + camera ops with lock/alarm blocked unless HOME_ASSISTANT_ALLOW_LOCKS=true; camera snapshots owner-only; fixed token-source intent-code divergence; de-sudo.

Security audit remediation: finished vague-trigger prune (61 to 27 action-scoped phrases), runtime warning when SSL_VERIFY=false, confirm-before-act + consent/privacy guidance, honest call_service declaration, declarative security + prompt-injection frontmatter, fixed corrupted SKILL.md code fences. All 15 snippets compile; read-only queries unchanged.

v2.1.0: Security scanner remediation. Added SKILL.md with full metadata (required HOME_ASSISTANT_URL + HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN declared, python packages declared, security disclosure). Removed .secrets file fallback. Removed external script references from README. Added Security Notes. No API changes.
Initial release: control lights, climate, cameras, energy, automations and get home summaries via Telegram. 15 snippets, 90 triggers, full HTTPS/SSL support, zero credentials in skill files.
